title: Hilary Duff Partners With Bath & Body Works to Bring Back Y2K With ‘Juicy’ New Body Care Line
summary: The singer/actress dropped her new hydration-focused body care line amid her ongoing world tour.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Lizzie McGuire fans have a new reason to relive the early aughts, thanks to a refreshing summer body care line.

Hilary Duff  has partnered with  Bath & Body Works  to launch Fruit Fusion , a new body care line inspired by the early 2000s. The collection includes hand sanitizers, lip oils, perfume mists, and hand and body lotions formulated with hyaluronic acid, an ingredient known for helping skin retain moisture. 

Shop Fruit Fusion at Bath & Body Works

Fruit Fusion offers four scents: Watermelon Whirl, Tangerine Twirl, Berry Bliss and Banana Blend. The fragrances are modeled after the fruity body splashes that were popular at Bath & Body Works during the early 2000s. 

And right now, you can mix and match to buy three items and get one for free when ordering online. It’s one of the best ways to save and try out the collection for yourself.

The collection’s release reflects a broader resurgence of Y2K-inspired culture , seen in projects like the Devil Wears Prada sequel and the Marc Jacobs Beauty relaunch, as well as renewed interest in early-2000s trends, such as low-rise jeans and the return of camcorders . 

The partnership also comes as Duff embarks on her first world tour since 2007, marking a notable return to touring after almost two decades.
